uk.s: The growth engine of the next decade—position early for high-conviction opportunities
The undisputed AI leader, with its Blackwell and Rubin platforms continuing to drive growth across the entire AI value chain
The global cloud-computing leader and the strongest executor in AI commercialization
Strong across both CPUs and GPUs, complementary to NVIDIA, and steadily expanding its data-center share
The established x86 giant and a key pillar of intelligent computing capacity
Why is the AI theme gaining market attention?

Global capex has entered a supercycle: Hyperscale cloud providers and frontier AI labs continue to ramp up investment in AI infrastructure, with capital expanding from model training into inference, data centers, and supporting power infrastructure. Wall Street increasingly views AI as a key force reshaping economic growth and corporate earnings.

Technology and commercialization are maturing in tandem: Inference accounts for a rapidly growing share of demand, while application-layer revenue is beginning to materialize. Institutions broadly believe that AI has moved beyond proof of concept and entered the stage of scalable deployment.
